## Software as a research output

- Research projects produce more than scientific publications and datasets

. . .

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column}
<br>

- Software plays a central role in:

  - Data collection and acquisition
  - Data cleaning and transformation
  - Data analysis and visualisation
  - Modelling and simulation
:::

::: {.column}
![](images/data-lifecycle-2_3_6.png){width=50% fig-align='right'}
:::
::::


. . .


{{< fa triangle-exclamation >}}&nbsp; However, software is often 
**less documented**, **shared** and **recognised** than data or 
publications

<br>

. . .

::: {.boxed .center}
**Software is a valuable research output<br>in its own right**
:::

## Before publishing a Software paper

|                           | Dimension                 | What should be in place?           | Examples / Tools           |
|:----:|:--------------|:--------------------------|:-------------------------|
| {{< fa code-branch >}}    | **Version control**       | Commit history, releases           | Git                        |
| {{< fa brands github >}}  | **Code source**           | Public repository                  | GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg   |
| {{< fa warehouse >}}      | **Archiving**             | Long-term preservation             | Zenodo, Software Heritage  |
| {{< fa tag >}}            | **Identification**        | Persistent & unique identifier     | DOI, SWHID                 |
| {{< fa book >}}           | **Documentation**         | Installation, documentation, usage | README, Website, Vignettes |
| {{< fa award >}}          | **License**               | Explicit open-source licence       | GPL, MIT, Apache 2.0       |
| {{< fa users >}}          | **Authorship**            | Maintainer, contributors & authors | ORCID, ROR, roles          |
| {{< fa quote-left >}}     | **Citation metadata**     | Structured citation information    | CITATION.cff, Codemeta     |
| {{< fa square-check >}}   | **Quality**               | Unit tests, CI/CD                  | testthat, GitHub Actions   |
| {{< fa handshake >}}      | **Community**             | Contribution guidelines, code of conduct | CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md |


## What is a Software Paper?

- A scientific **peer-reviewed** publication whose primary focus is a **software application** or tool

. . .

<br>

- It describes:

  - the **scientific context** and the problem addressed
  - the purpose and main **functionalities** of the software
  - its architecture and **technical design**
  - the **methods** and **algorithms implemented**
  - installation **requirements** and dependencies


## Why publish a Software paper?

<br><br><br><br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .fragment .center width=32%}

[{{< fa eye size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #4A8C78;"}
<br>

[**Visibility**]{style="color: #4A8C78 !important;"}

::: {.small}
Make research software discoverable<br>by the scientific community
:::
:::

::: {.column .fragment .center width=32%}

[{{< fa award size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C18A45;"}
<br>

[**Recognition**]{style="color: #C18A45;"}

::: {.small}
Give credit to software developers<br>and contributors
:::

:::

::: {.column .fragment .center width=32%}

[{{< fa link size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #075a80;"}
<br>

[**Traceability**]{style="color: #075a80;"}

::: {.small}
Establish a link between software<br>and scientific publications
:::
:::

::::

<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=16%}
:::

::: {.column .fragment .center width=32%}

[{{< fa rotate size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #795F8D;"}
<br>

[**Reproducibility**]{style="color: #795F8D;"}

::: {.small}
Document methods, workflows and<br>execution conditions
:::

:::

::: {.column .fragment .center width=32%}

[{{< fa recycle size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C76D62;"}
<br>

[**Reusability**]{style="color: #C76D62;"}

::: {.small}
Enable other teams to understand,<br>test and adapt the software
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=16%}
:::

::::


## Software paper, Data paper and co

<br><br><br><br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa flask size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C76D62;"}
<br>

[**Research article**]{style="color: #C76D62;"}

::: {.small}
Why was the research conducted,<br>and what were the findings?
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}

[{{< fa table size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #4A8C78 !important;"}
<br>

[**Data paper**]{style="color: #4A8C78 !important;"}

::: {.small}
What data were produced, and how<br>are they structured and documented?
:::

:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}
[{{< fa square-root-variable size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #075a80 !important;"}
<br>

[**Methods paper**]{style="color: #075a80 !important;"}

::: {.small}
What method was developed, why was it designed, and how can it be applied?
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=25%}
[{{< fa code size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C18A45;"}
<br>

[**Software paper**]{style="color: #C18A45;"}

::: {.small}
What software was developed, how<br>does it work, and how can it be reused?
:::
:::

::::

. . .

<br><br>

::: {.boxed .center}
**Same research ecosystem<br>Complementary outputs**
:::


## Example w/ the FORCIS project

{{< fa circle-arrow-right >}}&nbsp; A FRB-CESAB research project on **Foraminifera response to climatic stress**
 &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://www.fondationbiodiversite.fr/en/the-frb-in-action/programs-and-projects/le-cesab/forcis/)

<br><br><br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=32%}
[{{< fa flask size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C76D62;"}
<br>

[**7 x Research articles**]{style="color: #C76D62;"}

::: {.small}
Published in various journals<br>(Science, Nature, J. of Biogeography, etc.)
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=32%}
[{{< fa database size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #795F8D;"}
<br>

[**1 x Database**]{style="color: #795F8D;"}

::: {.small}
Released as a collection of CSV files<br>and archived on **Zenodo**
&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://zenodo.org/records/12724286)
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=32%}
[{{< fa table size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #4A8C78;"}
<br>

[**1 x Data paper**]{style="color: #4A8C78;"}

::: {.small}
Peer-reviewed and published in<br>**Scientific Data**
&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02264-2)
:::
:::

::::


<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .center width=16%}
:::

::: {.column .center width=32%}
[{{< fa cube size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #075a80;"}
<br>

[**1 x R Package**]{style="color: #075a80;"}

::: {.small}
Peer-reviewed by **rOpenSci**
&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://github.com/ropensci/software-review/issues/660)<br>
and archived on **CRAN**
&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://cran.r-project.org/package=forcis)
:::
:::

::: {.column .center width=32%}
[{{< fa code size=2xl >}}]{style="color: #C18A45;"}
<br>

[**1 x Software paper**]{style="color: #C18A45;"}

::: {.small}
Peer-reviewed and published in<br>**Journal of Open Source Software**
&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.09217)
:::

::: {.column .center width=16%}

## Where can you publish a Software paper?

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column}
- **Journals dedicated to research software**

  - Journal of Open Source Software &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://joss.theoj.org/)
  - Journal of Open Research Software &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://openresearchsoftware.metajnl.com/)
  - SoftwareX &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/softwarex)

:::

::: {.column}
- **Ecology-focused journals**

  - Methods in Ecology and Evolution &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/2041210x)
  - Ecology and Evolution &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/20457758)
  - Ecography &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://nsojournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/16000587)
  - PLOS Ecosystems &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://journals.plos.org/ecosystems/)
:::
::::

<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column}
- **Broader journals accepting software papers**

  - BMC Bioinformatics &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://bmcbioinformatics.biomedcentral.com/)
  - PLOS Computational Biology &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://collections.plos.org/collection/software/)
  - PLOS ONE &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/)
  - PeerJ &nbsp;&nbsp;[{{< fa up-right-from-square size=xs >}}](https://peerj.com/about/publications/#PeerJ)
:::
::: {.column}
:::
